data.description: Our single Leg Press has one orange seat and two footplates on a swinging arm. The user leans back, pushes the plates forward until the legs are nearly straight and lets them return slowly. It strengthens the large leg muscles that help with walking, climbing stairs and getting up from a chair, so it suits older residents as well as younger users. One-seat machines are easy to place in a small society garden or along a jogging track. It is finished in Play Orange. The measured drawing and warranty terms are sent with each quote. Under our standard terms, galvanised pipes are covered for 3 years and bearings for 1 year, which we will confirm in writing. Ask us for a quote.

items.pText: Our single Leg Press has one orange seat and two footplates on a swinging arm. The user leans back, pushes the plates forward until the legs are nearly straight and lets them return slowly. It strengthens the large leg muscles that help with walking, climbing stairs and getting up from a chair, so it suits older residents as well as younger users. One-seat machines are easy to place in a small society garden or along a jogging track. It is finished in Play Orange. The measured drawing and warranty terms are sent with each quote. Under our standard terms, galvanised pipes are covered for 3 years and bearings for 1 year, which we will confirm in writing. Ask us for a quote.

On the single Leg Press, the seat arm and its pivot carry most of the load, so these are the first parts to check during maintenance. It can go in self-standing on a firm slab or be grouted into soil. Keep the seat out of direct puddles by placing it on slightly raised ground.
